statement: Stable IDs and approved D05 selection are preserved.
Current primary authorities are recorded and each technical claim is bounded.
limitations: Reviewed web snapshots are metadata and claim records, not archived full pages.

statement: A reviewed, cited lesson moves through real draft/review/publication states.
limitations: Human external approval remains outside the application workflow.

statement: Published lesson revision is immutable and restore creates a new draft.
Request context and each trust boundary are explicit and versioned.
Authentication and authorization are evaluated as separate steps.
limitations: No token or public API implementation.

statement: Owner positive path returns ALLOW with deterministic trace.
Vulnerable cross-owner path incorrectly allows access and creates a finding.
Secure policy denies the same cross-owner request.
Client-supplied role/owner fields do not influence server-side authorization.
limitations: Fields retained only as bounded ignored context.

statement: Action/method/resource mapping is explicit and bounded.
Missing/malformed/unsupported state never produces a guessed ALLOW.
Response serialization excludes non-approved sensitive fields.
Security events/findings are deterministic and redact secrets.
limitations: Fallback secret scan is narrower than gitleaks.

statement: Remediation creates a new immutable policy revision.
Verification binds vulnerable run, remediation revision, and fixed run.
Replay is pinned to exact scenario/policy/rule/baseline revisions.
Scenario runs do not mutate the Enterprise Baseline.
All evidence is origin-labelled SIMULATED and actor-bound.
Mastery requires positive, negative, remediation, verification, provenance, and replay evidence.
limitations: Full mastery path enforced in service; no UI auto-award.

statement: Actual failures create specific ReviewTriggers.
Lesson/request/trace rendering keeps XSS markers inert.
limitations: Vitest jsdom DOM proof; in-app browser screenshot blocked separately under AC-023.

statement: Arabic RTL, technical LTR, keyboard, focus, mobile, and overflow gates pass.
limitations: Local background server launch rejected by execution approval environment; required in-app browser screenshots and live viewport/zoom observations not fabricated.

statement: VS-001 regressions and corrected criteria pass; no live exploit, scanner, connector, AI, or future slice is implemented.
limitations: Docker unavailable; no Docker PASS claimed.
